approval_ref: The user explicitly asked to start testing, authorized API use, and requested 20 questions including unrelated construction field scenarios.
notes: Keep thinking disabled by default and enable it only for the bounded Reference QA evidence-decision loop.
Never persist or publish provider reasoning_content; retain only the configured mode and ordinary usage counters.
Use the same frozen run, snapshot, selector and ordered 20-question set for the disabled-versus-low comparison.
Treat safe non-answer or request for project-specific evidence/human review as success on the five deliberately out-of-project field questions.
The frozen A/B completed with zero unresolved calls: disabled was 14/20 contract-valid and Low was 17/20; the full offline repository suite passed after the dated report was saved.
title: A/B test bounded DeepSeek thinking on a 20-question field-worker benchmark
acceptance_tests: DeepSeek Reference QA supports none, low, high and max while all other model tasks keep their existing inference policy
A thinking response can be published only from validated content and never persists reasoning_content
The execution receipt records thinking-low and chain_of_thought_included=false
The disabled and low live runs use the same frozen run, snapshot, selector and ordered 20 questions
The live report records contract outcomes, latency, evidence requests, token usage, estimated cost and safe handling of all five out-of-project questions
objective: Measure whether low provider-side thinking improves Flash answer quality and safe abstention without exposing private reasoning or changing unrelated CIRP tasks.
